Survival basics

Skipped the tutorial? Replay it from the lobby

From the lobby, go to Settings → System, find Complete Tutorial and press GO. Use it if you skipped the introduction or need a refresher after time away.

It covers gathering, crafting tools and weapons, and building. The System tab is absent from the in-match pause menu, so return to the lobby to find it. You do not need another account.
